manage.title: Manage
manage.update.note: From the terminal, restart Claude Code after the update.
manage.updateAll: Update every plugin from this marketplace
manage.updateAll.note: claude plugin marketplace update without a name only refreshes the listings; it installs no new versions.
manage.autoUpdate.json: Or add autoUpdate to the marketplace entry in your settings file:
manage.autoUpdate.jsonLabel: settings entry that turns on auto-update
manage.autoUpdate.note: Auto-update is off by default for this marketplace.
manage.disable.note: While a plugin that depends on it is enabled ({plugins}), Claude Code refuses and prints the command that disables both in order.
manage.uninstall.note: --prune also removes the dependencies that were installed with it and that no other plugin needs.
manage.uninstall.project: For a plugin the project enables, Claude Code asks: disable it for you only, or uninstall it for everyone.
manage.pin.note: A pin applies to the whole catalog, not only to this plugin. Removing the marketplace uninstalls every plugin installed from it and deletes their saved data, so reinstall the others afterwards. To unpin, run the same commands without #{tag}.
